items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now did you make records with Victor Young and the Brunswick orchestra? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, many.

ctx.x: No, okay. Victor Young and his orchestra, do you remember Victor Young?
Victor Young, I know him well.
You know him well. Tell me about Victor Young. What kind of person, what kind of musician?
